description: List L1↔L2 messages on Starknet (newest first). Filter by block, contract, or direction. Unbounded lists use cursor pagination (pass `cursor` from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor); block-scoped lists use page numbers and return lastPage.

block.description: Filter by block number, block hash, or "pre_confirmed".

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor. Omit for the first page. Cannot be combined with `block`.

network.description: Network to query. Defaults to the server's configured network (mainnet).

page.description: Page number (1-based). Only honored for block-scoped lists.

pageSize.description: Items per page: 10, 25, 50, or 100. Defaults to 25. Keep small to save context.

timestampFrom.description: Inclusive lower timestamp bound (unix seconds) for the cursor-paginated lists. Cannot be combined with `block`.

timestampTo.description: Inclusive upper timestamp bound (unix seconds) for the cursor-paginated lists. Cannot be combined with `block`.

name: list_messages
